title: 축소한 W2 병렬 가지의 폭과 깊이 비교
hypothesis: Experiment 74 (branch 64 channels x 4 blocks, 0.33M) kept 42% of the C2MS RR PSNR gain over the original (SAM 18%), so most of the gain needs branch capacity. Between 74 and C2MS (128 x 8, 2.43M), keeping the width (128 x 4) or keeping the depth (64 x 8) shows which of the two the gain depends on, and how close a 1.05-1.67M model comes to C2MS.

evidence.experiment_74: 64 x 4 branch: RR -0.521 dB, SAM +0.317 deg against 53 C2MS; +0.385 dB against the original; training MSE stayed 1.28x C2MS from epoch 50 (capacity limit, not under-training)
evidence.experiment_74_benchmark: single job 0.148 s/step at 41-47% GPU use; two jobs 0.189 s/step each (about 1.5x throughput)

arms.C2MS_W128D4: C2MS with the W2 branch PixelUnshuffle(2) -> 1x1 256->128 -> 4 residual blocks at 128 channels -> 1x1 128->256 (zero init) -> PixelShuffle(2); the C2MS width with half the depth
arms.C2MS_W64D8: the same with 1x1 256->64 -> 8 residual blocks at 64 channels -> 1x1 64->256; the C2MS depth with half the width

comparisons.official: each arm against the archived 53 C2MS of the same seed (criteria v2.4, RR only)
comparisons.run_to_run: each arm against the 57 retrained C2MS (reference)
comparisons.retention: share of the C2MS RR PSNR gain over the original 43 C0 kept by each arm, read with 74 (64 x 4) as a capacity curve
comparisons.width_vs_depth: C2MS_W128D4 against C2MS_W64D8 (same seed, reported, not a judgement)

control_policy: No new control run: the archived 53 C2MS of the same seed is the official control and the 57 retrained C2MS shows run-to-run variation.

judgement.criteria: docs/judgement_criteria.md v2.4: RR PSNR, SAM, ERGAS against the same-seed 53 C2MS; single seed noise threshold 0.06 dB; FR QNR/D_lambda/D_s reference only
judgement.reported: validation PSNR/SAM per epoch, RR against 53, 57 and the original, share of the C2MS gain kept, FR QNR reference, epoch time of two concurrent trainings

stages.1_screen: QB seed 42, both arms trained at the same time
stages.reading: the arms are smaller than C2MS; the result reports the v2.4 label against 53 and the share of the gain kept, together with 74 and C2MS
stages.next: seeds 43/44 or GF2/WV3 only after user approval

limits: two trainings share the GPU; cudnn benchmark may pick different algorithms under load, which can change floating-point details but not the training recipe
expected_duration: about 4 h for both arms together (74: 68 s per epoch alone; two concurrent jobs measured 1.37x slower per step)
precision: FP16 AMP core training with GradScaler; FP32 transforms, loss, validation and evaluation (as 53/63)
selection: minimum original-scale validation MSE including epoch 0, earliest exact tie; test never used for selection (same rule as 53/63)
